title: Pokemon TCG Sylveon Poke Ball Pattern 040/131 Sv: Prismatic Evolutions
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokemon TCG Sylveon Poke Ball Pattern card from the set "Sv: Prismatic Evolutions". This rare card features the character Sylveon, a Fairy-type Pokemon with 120 HP. Manufactured by The Pokemon Company in 2025, this standard-sized card is illustrated by Minaminami Take and has a textured Poke Ball reverse holo finish. It is a valuable addition for collectors and players of the Pokémon Trading Card Game.
